'''Neevat''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] hunter living on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], and a rival of [[Harno]]. In order to damage Harno's reputation, Neevat spread rumors that Harno or his associates drugged creatures before his hunts, thereby making them easier targets. Incensed by the rumors, Harno confronted Neevat; in the ensuing fight, Harno accidentally killed Neevat, and fled the planet to avoid retribution.
